trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: Price action executed a clean liquidity sweep of the minor buy-side liquidity (BSL) at 78662.75, tapping into the H1 resistance level at 78747.23, which resulted in a strong wick rejection on the H1 candle. This rejection aligns with the dominant bearish trend on the H4 timeframe where EMA50 and EMA200 are in a bearish configuration, indicating that the upward move was merely a liquidity grab before continuation.

Confluence 2: The preemptive entry zone sits within a key H1 supply zone (78750 - 78900) which coincides with the 78750 Quarter Theory level. This zone also aligns with the mitigation of an unmitigated bearish FVG on the H1 timeframe. The rejection at the upper Bollinger Band on the M15 timeframe, combined with high ATR volatility, confirms that the price is reacting strongly to this premium supply zone.

Confluence 3: On the lower timeframes (M5), the price has executed a bearish Break of Structure (BOS) by breaking below the higher low at 78646.00. This shift in market structure marks the transition of the H4 candle from its expansion phase to its distribution phase under Candle Range Theory, forming a bearish double-top pattern. This structural shift is validated by the M15 RSI declining from overbought territory (now at 54.3), confirming loss of bullish momentum.

Confluence 4: The high of 78747.23 represents a precise 0.618 Fibonacci retracement of the recent H4 downswing (79485.00 to 77620.01), which intersects with a bearish trendline bounce. This mitigation of the premium retracement level occurred on declining volume, as shown by the flat OBV, indicating buying exhaustion and a high probability of a preemptive wick-rejection.

Confluence 5: The defensive staff zone is located at the +2 Standard Deviation band of the short-term price range, representing an extreme overextended state. This aligns with the Malaysian SNR resistance and the bearish H1 order block. The Stochastic and CCI indicators are showing a bearish crossover from the overbought zone, confirming that the defensive staff is highly likely to hold and reject any further upward attempts.
